items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: like Bob Burns and his bazooka.

ctx.x: ...What can you say about Cuba and who was he with?

He was with McKinney Cotton Pickers; and I saw him and he had this little sock cymbal that you used to slide your foot in. I have one at the shop. And by me running around like I said, all my friends never had what I had, the carnivals and circuses and what have you. It was through necessity that I went and got a pipe.
